authorizationPolicy.jobOwnership: submitting principal; ownerless pre-deployment records expire within 24 hours

executionPolicy.researchCompute: simulation+tournament; SQS maximum concurrency 2; 2,048 MiB; 60 seconds; 150 jobs/UTC month
executionPolicy.training: replays+labels; SQS maximum concurrency 2; 2,048 MiB; 60 seconds; 100 jobs/UTC month
executionPolicy.global: 250 jobs/UTC month; 25 jobs/principal/UTC day; two attempts/job; 12 alarms across both pools

artifactPolicy.identity: worker-result-v1 keyed by 64-hex job id and submitting principal
artifactPolicy.storage: separate worker_artifacts Mongo collection; exact JSON payload plus SHA-256 and byte length
artifactPolicy.retention: same absolute 24-hour expiry as owning job; TTL indexed
artifactPolicy.compatibility: pre-change inline results remain readable; unversioned status loads stored artifact; contract-v2 status remains metadata-only
artifactPolicy.failure: missing, mismatched, oversized, or corrupt artifacts fail closed and are never regenerated in web requests
